svg.title: Red-Orange Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and standardized vivid palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Observed red-orange maps to vivid orange.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-new-paintings-05-1998/lightbox/works/red-orange-curve-1997-5074; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
